mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy accommodation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate delayed rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE has exceeded 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales growth (RSAFS) exceeds industrial production growth (INDPRO) by more than 0.5 percentage points over three months, it signals robust consumer demand outpacing supply constraints, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (RSAFS growth - INDPRO growth > 0.5pp) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), rising interest rates compress corporate profit margins and reduce equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 1.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has been below 1200 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and declines in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a tight labor market with monetary tightening, which pressures corporate margins and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing weakness signals an impending economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 100.
